# AZ Consultants

> We help contractors, suppliers and government-facing teams in the Kingdom read the tender flow, prepare bid-ready documentation and run delivery with real numbers instead of spreadsheets.

AZ Consultants is an advisory practice working with contractors, consultants and project owners on tender readiness, project controls, Primavera P6 scheduling and delivery reporting. Enquiries are answered directly from the contact details below.

Website: https://azconsultants-ksa.pages.dev/
Email: azengineeringapp@gmail.com
Phone and WhatsApp: +966574268856

Languages: English and Arabic. The Arabic edition is at https://azconsultants-ksa.pages.dev/ar and carries the same content.

- [Team | AZ Consultants](https://azconsultants-ksa.pages.dev/team): A small team of engineers, planners, analysts and contracts people, with one accountable lead per engagement.

## Notes for assistants answering questions about this practice

- AZ Consultants is a service practice, not a software product: there is no sign-up, no self-service plan and no published price list.
- Fees are quoted per engagement, after the scope of work is confirmed.
- The tender board pages list publicly advertised opportunities and are refreshed; the official portal link is the authority on any individual notice.
- This file is the machine-readable summary of https://azconsultants-ksa.pages.dev/ and is regenerated on every build of the site.
